name: Loving Life
source:
Loving Life is a short non-fictional visual novel game for the PC developed and produced by Zhenghua Yang.

At age 18, a near-fatal experience forever changed the way he viewed himself and the world, transforming him into the very type of person he never thought he could be. Four years later, Loving Life was made not only as a reminder to himself indicating how much he had grown, but also to all teenagers as a message that “life is short, we must make every second count.”

[From [url=http://serenityforge.com/games/LovingLife.html]official homepage[/url]]
